questions.q: Where does Perel say adult views on sex and intimacy largely come from?
a: Childhood experiences and early emotional attachment
Advice from friends and popular magazines
The length of a couple’s relationship
Genetic traits inherited from your parents
questions.why: Lesson 1 explains that our erotic blueprint can reflect childhood trauma and early attachment patterns.

questions.q: Why can having children dampen a couple’s erotic life?
a: Security and responsibility push out the excitement and unpredictability desire needs
Parents naturally lose all physical attraction to each other
Children require so much sleep that parents stop dreaming
Couples stop loving each other once a child arrives
questions.why: Lesson 2 says eroticism needs excitement and danger, but parents understandably choose security.

questions.q: What does Perel recommend for busy parents who want more intimacy?
a: Schedule time for dates and let yourselves anticipate them
Wait for spontaneous desire to return on its own
Avoid planning so the encounter feels unpredictable
Focus entirely on the children until they grow up
questions.why: Lesson 2 suggests setting aside time, since anticipating a planned date can itself fuel excitement.

questions.q: How does Perel suggest couples should handle temptation?
a: Acknowledge it honestly and turn it into part of the game
Deny that either partner could ever notice anyone else
Avoid discussing attraction to other people entirely
Test the relationship by flirting outside it
questions.why: Lesson 3 says admitting temptation asserts freedom and commitment, and fantasy can turn a threat into fun.

questions.q: What did Dylan’s story illustrate about childhood and intimacy?
a: Repressing emotion as a child can block vulnerability and connection later
Early relationships have no lasting effect on adult sexuality
Therapy is useless for problems rooted in the past
Anonymous sex is a healthy way to avoid emotional pain
questions.why: Lesson 1 describes how Dylan’s father taught him to hide feelings, leading him to use anonymous sex as protection.
